text_block_list.text:
Super Creek ran through the race despite 
feeling under the weather.

After the race, her poor condition finally 
reached its limit, and she collapsed.

Super Creek undergoes a medical 
examination. However, the doctor cannot 
identify the cause of her poor condition 
and warns her to sit out the spring 
Classics.

Super Creek wept at being unable to offer 
victory to Trainer. She set her sights on 
the autumn Kikuka Sho as her provisional 
goal.
